request.prompt: Premium motion-design brand ident for Klipt, a modern AI content studio, in the style of a world-class agency or TV network sting. Clean warm cream background (#FAF7F3) with soft blurred aurora glows of indigo blue, violet and coral red. Elegant, minimal, luxurious, glossy 3D materials, soft studio light, subtle depth of field, smooth confident camera, 24 fps, no people, no extra text, no other logos, no watermark. The final logo must match the last frame exactly: a dark rounded vertical bar and a play triangle with a blue-to-red gradient, and the word Klipt in dark ink. End card sting: on the soft cream canvas, many thin translucent rounded cards like social media posts float and drift in depth, glowing in indigo, violet and red; they glide together and fold into the play triangle, the logo appears, then the tagline and the web address fade up beneath it and everything settles.
